issues.title: CHK-026 still fails now and then on a KO swap: a head changes by up to 4 percent (3 allowed), invisibly, in Chapters V, XVII and III
issues.chapter: ffx2-vegnagun-shuyin (this run); sin-fins-core and braskas-final-aeon (the lane's runs and live's)
issues.expected: At every pose swap a figure's head changes by at most 3 percent.
issues.observed: This run: 17 of 18 chapters PASS. Chapter V FAILS on two swaps of Yuna, her early KO in link 2: hurt to KO x1.0405 (head 10.5 px to 10.9 px: 0.4 px) and KO to idle x0.9616, registered heads, the lying plane against the standing one in the same frame; her four later KOs in the same run read x0.9959, x1.0099, x0.9918, x1.0076 and pass, as do live 39.1's two Yuna KOs in both live runs of the chapter (round 23 and mine: x0.998 to x1.008). Live passed because Yuna was not KO'd at that point of those two fights (a run-to-run difference of the real-time route); the r392-size lane saw the same kind of swap fail in Chapter V on builds with live's table (White Mage and Dark Knight KOs at x1.027 to x1.041) and in Chapter XVII (Yuna x1.0334, x0.9698, x0.9696, the same three live 39.1 failed in round 23), and a three-frame flash of the possessed Valefor's KO painting in Chapter III (mass x1.349); each of those chapters passed in other runs. The lane's chart of 165 KO swaps shows the head ratio is a function of the stage camera's perspective (x1.04 where the camera looks up, x0.97 where it converges), which no registration value fixes and which this release does not touch. Severity: the heads in question are 10 to 40 px and the pair is a KO cut that changes everything else in the frame, so a player cannot see it; it keeps CHK-026 failing (and would cap Bailey's sub-scores in a deep review). Chapter V on live 39.1's own bytes, run again by me (1,416 s of battle, 58.7 fps): CHK-026 PASS, registered head 1.1 percent, its two Yuna KOs x0.998 to x1.008 (round 23's run the same); it did not have the early KO that fails here.
issues.repro: continuity.mjs --chapters=ffx2-vegnagun-shuyin (or sin-fins-core) on the candidate; the failing swaps are listed in continuity.json under swaps with failHead.
issues.where: src/engine/PaintedActor.ts (PaintedRest.placePlane rolls the lying plane; the head box is not held per camera) (suspected)
issues.fix: The lane's option 1: emit each pose's registered head box with its scale and have PaintedActor rescale the active plane about its feet so the projected head box equals the idle's (needs Bailey's eye and a focused review: it touches the presenter's core); or decide that a KO swap is judged on the plane's own units (option 2).
issues.acceptanceCheck: CHK-026 PASS in 18 of 18 chapters over three runs, including a Chapter V and a Chapter XVII run in which a girl is KO'd.

issues.title: At 21:9 (2560x1080) the first Bahamut plan is a coin flip between two sizes in both builds, and the candidate's lock holds the result for the whole fight
issues.requirement: docs/handoff/r392-boss-scale.md ('The first plan is the 39.1 build's'; 'A lock is as good as the first plan: a first plan that lands on a transient state would keep that size for the phase'; ultrawide windows were not measured)
issues.expected: The first plan, and so the size the lock holds, is the same in every run.
issues.observed: At 2560x1080 the first plan lands on the full BOSS SCALE step (k 1.387, Bahamut 681 to 682 px at the settled first menu) or on step 0.7 (k 1.272, 624 to 626 px), in both builds. Live 39.1's first menu (the lane's harness: real keys, seed 1, menus settled) took the full step in 3 of 6 runs and step 0.7 in the rest, and it re-plans at every menu (menus 3 and 4 of its two four-menu runs: 628 to 629 and 486 to 500 px). The candidate's first plan took the full step in 1 of 7 harness runs; in the other 6 its tries read '1:x gate0.022 ... 0.7:ok' (the full step fails the HUD gate by 0.022), and the lock then keeps that k at every menu. Through the real reveal (one Enter a second, seed 1) the candidate held the larger size (688 to 690 px at the first menu) in 3 of 9 runs, two of them on a quiet machine, and the smaller (629 to 632 px) in the rest; live 39.1's reveal ends at 630 to 632 px in 6 of 6 runs. At 1024x768, 1280x720, 1600x900, 2000x1012 and 2560x1440 the two builds' first menus agree to within 4.2 px. In the larger case the entrance push cuts his painted box 60 to 68 px over the top edge for 1 to 2.5 seconds (both builds cut it 42 to 64 px at 1280x720 to 2000x1012; live's push at 21:9 cuts 2 to 6 px); he is whole at every menu in every run. The lane named the risk (a transient first plan is kept for the phase) and measured 1600x900 only.
issues.repro: reveal.mjs --chapter=ffx2-bahamut --size=2560x1080 --tag=x (real keys, the scene read one Enter a second; about one run in three), and bs-measure.mjs --chapter=ffx2-bahamut --size=2560x1080 --menus=4 --seed=1 on both builds (docs/handoff/r392-boss-scale-evidence/)
issues.where: src/engine/fx/mix/framing.ts decide and scaleLock.ts holdEarly: the first plan at this window shape is a coin flip between the full step and step 0.7 (suspected, not traced)
issues.fix: Let the first plan settle before it is held, or decide the HUD gate with a margin at ultrawide shapes; either size is whole at every menu, so it is polish.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Ten reveal runs at 2560x1080 hold one size, not a mix of 630 and 688 px.
